definitions.explanation: The physical sensation or quality of being cold to the touch.
An unfriendly, distant, or emotionally cold attitude or manner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{氷|こおり}→氷：02753_koori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{冷|つめ}たさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I felt the coldness of the ice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{冷|つめ}たさ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気持|きも}ちいい→気持ちいい：09583_kimochiii⟧。
examples.english: The coldness of the water feels refreshing.
I woke up from the coldness of the floor on a winter morning.

examples.english: I could no longer bear the coldness of the people around me.

notes:
{冷|つめ}たさ is the noun form of the i-adjective ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧, formed by replacing い with さ. Like the adjective, it can describe both physical cold and emotional coldness.

FORMS:
This follows the standard ～さ pattern for converting i-adjectives into nouns: ⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧ → ⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧, ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ → ⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧, ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧ → {冷|つめ}たさ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冷|つめ}たさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: feel the coldness
- {冷|つめ}たさ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: the coldness remains
- {冷|つめ}たさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧: get used to the cold
- ⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{冷|つめ}たさ: the coldness of one's attitude

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧: coldness (of weather/air) — used for ambient temperature; {冷|つめ}たさ is for touch or emotional coldness
- ⟦{冷|ひ}え→冷え：19822_hie⟧: chill; cooling — the sensation of becoming cold, or coldness in the body
